protocol.order: Original controls, then one512 seed from every generator before second seeds, then additional small/medium controls. Rotate four variants by case index. Stop only between matched quartets for budget.
metrics: gradient preparation and active elapsed time
protocol.aggregation: Per-map matched quartet; report every seed, equal-map geometric means and large-map subset; seed consistency not repeated-timing confidence.
protocol.exclusions: Only output mismatch, incomplete run or observed build/test affinity overlap. Retain all raw rows; no timing outlier exclusions.
protocol.correctness: Same immutable saved inputs; initial/final checksums, ticks, termination and final save hashes match master.
protocol.scope: All67 playable generators: two fresh512-square seeds each,16 stratified128/256 controls,original8 fixtures; supported max512, no1024 generator fixtures. Reserved kernel holdouts untouched.
protocol.master_delta: Since PR rebase base4ca7b0863: packaging, docs and WSS backpressure changes; no offline simulation/gradient changes. PR head is kept exactly as pushed.
protocol.termination: 5,000-tick cap; any legitimate earlier ending must match across variants
protocol.timing_budget: User selected two seeds per generator while retaining about1-2hour target. One rotated matched quartet per map; stop admission at120minutes from campaign-clock; no significance claims from single timings.
protocol.primary_question: Does final automatic mode follow established-plan design, what CPU overhead does it add versus master/forcedCPU, and where does GPU offer unused CPU-demand reductions? No live optimizer exists in production.
protocol.primary_efficiency_metric: benchmark_run_cpu_ns / benchmark_measured_ticks (all-thread process CPU per warm simulation tick), with matching simulation and gradient work counts
protocol.secondary_metrics: gradient callback/preparation elapsed work, total join waits, PR-only publication wait breakdown, process CPU/RSS; game wall and tick tails are regression guards
protocol.automatic_contract: Defaultautomatic remainsCPU; no accelerator initialization, telemetryprocessing or probes with accountingoff. Performance difference versusCPU is overhead/noise, not evidence of learned selection.
protocol.isolation: Existing cgroup-v2 exclusive balanced partition reserves 0-7,16-23; games use0-7; affinity observer uses23. Prior affinity-only samples retained separately, not pooled.
